snippet.title: Introducing Hungry Hungry Hippos: Move and Munch
snippet.description:
Hungry Hungry Hippos: Move and Munch has arrived on Nex Playground
Compete against up to 3 players to see who can gobble up the most fruits before the timer runs out.

4 Get ready for a chomping good time with your family and friends!
